result: Implemented exact-Workstream presentation-state capture and restoration across projection refresh, invalidation, profile/activity selection, tab mutation, and contribution operations.
implementation: Captures focus, semantic selection, nonzero scroll positions, and canonical active tab by stable semantic/layout/contribution identifiers.
Restores only when the exact Workstream remains authoritative and the next projection revision is not stale.
Missing semantic objects are skipped without focusing or scrolling unrelated content; canonical active tabs may retain focus but are never locally selected.
Projection refreshes preserve the mounted Desktop shell and restore presentation after Svelte commits the canonical projection.
acceptance: Polling or live updates do not reset operator context.
Refresh preserves focus, scroll, selection, and active tab when the semantic object remains.
Events or projections from another Workstream cannot restore presentation state into the active Canvas.
Restoration does not synthesize local eligibility or layout state.
